rejected_rule.statement: An owner who acquiesces in the making of improvements is stopped from disputing the right of the improver to be compensated on the same footing as a bona fide possessor.
rejected_rule.supporting_quote: In this view of the law the appellant is entitled to retain possession till he is compensated. It remains for me to consider whether the District Judge is right in awarding damages to the plaintiff at the rate of Rs. 10 permensem.
